subject.title: [Feature]: Mobile chat polish pack: model picker favorites, reasoning gating, context usage, link previews, math, streaming reveal

question: Should OpenClaw keep this mobile chat polish bundle as the coordinating maintainer issue, and which slices should be split for security or protocol review before implementation?
rationale: The request spans new mobile UX behavior, persistent app preferences, additive gateway metadata, and a security-sensitive link-preview default, so automation cannot safely choose the product scope.

options.title: Keep as roadmap bundle
options.body: Keep this issue open as the coordinating item and require each slice to land through small independently reviewed PRs.

options.title: Split link previews
options.body: Track tap-to-expand link previews separately for security review while leaving the non-network polish items here.

options.title: Defer mobile polish
options.body: Pause the bundle until companion app polish is prioritized above setup, stability, and security work.

recommendation.title: Keep as roadmap bundle
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the coordinating item and require each slice to land through small independently reviewed PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue and recent mobile chat scaffolding both point to steipete as the best available owner for product scoping.
